$comment: District content pack for Fisherman's Wharf (docs/ai-layer.md, District content packs): 40 robot barks and 40 people lines that name local streets, grades, fog and landmarks; a bounty set with the district's local tell; billboard and bus-wrap copy for its slots. People lines are plain English: no accent spelling, no ethnicity, nothing about rent, poverty or crime.

provenance.review: Pending: a second agent session reads every line against the checklist in docs/ai-layer.md, then the user reviews a stratified 10% sample.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Chowder delivery on Jefferson St. Lid on. Steam contained.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The sea lion docks are loud today. I keep a polite distance.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Cable car turnaround at Hyde and Beach. I love watching it spin.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Sourdough in the bag. Seagulls in the sky. Eyes forward.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Carrying postcards to the post box. Somebody misses somebody.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Jefferson St is all tourists and sunshine. Mostly tourists.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Fresh crab on ice for a restaurant. Walking extra smoothly.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The bay is right there. I admire it from the sidewalk.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Delivering a sweatshirt to someone who forgot it gets cold here.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Hyde St is steep. I take it slow. The cable car takes it slower.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Pier walk at sunset. I stop. Everyone stops.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Souvenir run: one snow globe, very fragile, very silly.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Gulls overhead. I keep my lid closed and my thoughts kind.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Fog horn from the bay. I beep back quietly. Just once.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The wharf smells like salt and fried things. I don't smell. I'm told.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Directions to the cable car? Two blocks up. Follow me.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The fishing boats come in at dawn. So do I.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Holding the sweatshirt shop door open. Cold wind, warm welcome.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Sorry! A tourist group stopped and so did I. And then I didn't.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Excuse me, I'll step around your photo. You look great.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Apologies, the gull came out of nowhere. For both of us.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Sorry, Jefferson St is crowded. I'll be very small.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Pardon me, I'm turning toward the pier. Slowly.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Premium sea lion viewing. Scan here.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Free QR code! It leads to another QR code!

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Tourists are just users who haven't onboarded yet.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: That chowder bowl is now a Moat Labs bowl.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Cable car? Sounds legacy. Try our scooter. It's me.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Your souvenir has been personalised with our logo.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Sightseeing is free. Seeing is extra.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: I'm not handing out flyers. I'm distributing value.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: This pier is now in private beta.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: The bay view has been paywalled. For your convenience.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: One more flyer. Nobody took the last forty.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: That Footman's crab is getting acquired.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Updating this souvenir robot. It'll sell my stickers now.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Sticking an ad on the cable car shelter. Prime real estate.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Salt spray! From the actual bay! My flyers!

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Not on Jefferson St! The tourists will post this!

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: My QR codes are running! Literally running!

peopleLines.speaker: tourist
peopleLines.text: We heard the sea lions before we saw them.

peopleLines.speaker: tourist
peopleLines.text: Is it always this cold in summer? It's always this cold in summer.

peopleLines.speaker: tourist
peopleLines.text: The chowder comes in a bread bowl. I'm never leaving.

peopleLines.speaker: tourist
peopleLines.text: That robot just carried a crab past me like a waiter.

peopleLines.speaker: tourist
peopleLines.text: We rode the cable car down. My hat did not survive.

peopleLines.speaker: tourist
peopleLines.text: The fog came in and the whole bay disappeared.

peopleLines.speaker: tourist
peopleLines.text: Everyone keeps buying sweatshirts. I get it now.

peopleLines.speaker: tourist
peopleLines.text: Look, the robot stopped to let the tour group pass.

peopleLines.speaker: tourist
peopleLines.text: There's a robot handing out QR codes. Don't scan it.

peopleLines.speaker: tourist
peopleLines.text: I took a picture of the bay. It's just fog. It's beautiful.

peopleLines.speaker: tourist
peopleLines.text: The gulls here have no fear at all.

peopleLines.speaker: tourist
peopleLines.text: The turnaround is so cool. They push it by hand!

peopleLines.speaker: tourist
peopleLines.text: I bought sourdough for the plane. It won't make it to the plane.

peopleLines.speaker: tourist
peopleLines.text: My kids want to see the sea lions again. My ears do not.

peopleLines.speaker: vendor
peopleLines.text: Sweatshirts! For the summer you didn't pack for!

peopleLines.speaker: vendor
peopleLines.text: The robots are good customers. They never haggle.

peopleLines.speaker: vendor
peopleLines.text: Busy day on Jefferson. Busy every day on Jefferson.

peopleLines.speaker: vendor
peopleLines.text: The fog's good for business. Hot coffee, warm hats.

peopleLines.speaker: vendor
peopleLines.text: That Footman buys bread from me every morning. Always says thank you.

peopleLines.speaker: vendor
peopleLines.text: I've seen a hundred robots go by and only one tried to sell me a flyer.

peopleLines.speaker: vendor
peopleLines.text: Postcards, five for a dollar, robots carry them for free.

peopleLines.speaker: vendor
peopleLines.text: Weekends the whole wharf is shoulder to shoulder.

peopleLines.speaker: tourist
peopleLines.text: That robot keeps trying to give everyone a flyer.

peopleLines.speaker: tourist
peopleLines.text: Why is that one lingering by the cable car without riding it?

peopleLines.speaker: tourist
peopleLines.text: A robot just stepped around a puddle like it was lava.

peopleLines.speaker: tourist
peopleLines.text: That one's battery always says full. Mine never does.

peopleLines.speaker: tourist
peopleLines.text: I think that robot is following the other robot.

peopleLines.speaker: tourist
peopleLines.text: That robot asked me to rate the pier. The pier is fine!

peopleLines.speaker: local
peopleLines.text: Tourists in shorts, locals in parkas. Every single day.

peopleLines.speaker: local
peopleLines.text: The fog rolls in off the bay at four. Set your watch.

peopleLines.speaker: local
peopleLines.text: Can't see the island today. Island's having a quiet day.

peopleLines.speaker: local
peopleLines.text: The foghorns are the real soundtrack of this neighbourhood.

peopleLines.speaker: local
peopleLines.text: Sunny morning, foggy lunch, freezing dinner. Classic wharf.

peopleLines.speaker: local
peopleLines.text: When the fog's in, the chowder line doubles.

peopleLines.speaker: local
peopleLines.text: The fog smells like salt and the bakery. Not bad, honestly.

peopleLines.speaker: local
peopleLines.text: The bay goes grey and the gulls get louder.

peopleLines.speaker: local
peopleLines.text: I always tell visitors: bring a jacket, then bring another one.

peopleLines.speaker: local
peopleLines.text: The sun comes out for ten minutes and everyone cheers.

peopleLines.speaker: local
peopleLines.text: The fog sits on the water like a blanket. A damp blanket.

peopleLines.speaker: local
peopleLines.text: Cold here is a feature, not a bug.

bounties.posting: A Footman is handing out QR flyers on Jefferson St, and Moat Labs posters keep going up on the shelters.
bounties.tellHint: Good robots never push flyers at anyone.

bounties.posting: Chowder deliveries going missing near the waterfront.
bounties.tellHint: One of the pair hands out QR flyers between grabs.

bounties.posting: Good Footmen by the cable car turnaround are coming back 'updated'.
bounties.tellHint: Look for the flyer-pusher by the turntable queue.

lastSeen.label: Beach St near the sea lion docks

bounties.posting: Parked cars on Beach St are hearing pairing chimes.
bounties.tellHint: The lookout pretends to hand out flyers.
